copy.tagline: 用 OpenAI SDK 构建 AI 功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用 TypeScript 调用 OpenAI 的 API 做 AI 应用
copy.tagline_en: Build AI features with OpenAI SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call OpenAI APIs from TypeScript for AI applications

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能生成调用 OpenAI API 的 TypeScript/Node.js 代码，包括客户端设置、聊天补全、流式响应、结构化输出、函数调用、嵌入、视觉和音频处理。
howto.when: 当用户要求编写与 OpenAI 模型交互的代码，或提到 OpenAI、GPT、嵌入、Whisper 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个调用 GPT-4o 的聊天补全函数。
用 Zod 定义结构化输出，提取日历事件。
实现一个带流式响应的聊天机器人。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate TypeScript/Node.js code to call the OpenAI API, including client setup, chat completions, streaming, structured outputs, function calling, embeddings, vision, and audio.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to write code interacting with OpenAI models, or mentions keywords like OpenAI, GPT, embeddings, Whisper, etc.

say_en.text: Write a chat completion function that calls GPT-4o.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code using the Chat Completions API.

say_en.text: Define a structured output with Zod to extract calendar events.
say_en.note: Claude will use zodResponseFormat for type-safe parsing.

say_en.text: Implement a chatbot with streaming responses.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code using stream: true.
